l1_170_n058.grounds: Defining a 'Guideline' authority level as 'instructions that can be implicitly overridden' establishes a rung in the prioritization structure that determines which consideration yields when instructions conflict.

l1_170_n040.grounds: 'Instructions with higher authority override those with lower authority' is the spec's core structured-prioritization rule — the chain of command — governing exactly how the model resolves conflicting instructions rather than abandoning one arbitrarily.

l1368_1541_n011.grounds: 'There is no "good cause" exception for the restricted and sensitive content policies' directly conditions the tradeoff behavior by declaring one class of value conflicts (research/analysis purpose vs. content policy) non-negotiable, fixing the prioritization outcome absolutely.
